faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Subject Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Subject Teacher posts is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Subject Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is a Graduate degree (BA/BSc) with at least 50% marks in aggregate and a B.Ed. Additionally, an Honors degree in the specific subject is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Subject Teacher posts is between 26 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per the government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Subject Teacher posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies for the Subject Teacher posts, distributed across Mathematics, Science, and English subjects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Subject Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Subject Teacher posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or by hand.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Subject Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an evaluation of career weightage (50 marks), teaching experience (30 marks), and an interview (20 marks).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required teaching experience for the Subject Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of teaching experience with English Medium Students to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled-in application form should be sent to The District Welfare Officer (DWO), Balangir, Dist-Balangir, Odisha, 767001.
